`docs/timelock-and-governance-spec.md`. Reads existing UUPS contract addresses from the deployment output (.json) and the admin/guardian Fordefi addresses from the network config (.json). Run order: this is the **last** deployment step (after `00`\u2013`12`). It is intentionally kept out of the `deploy-all` Make target so the deployer can confirm the protocol configuration is correct before performing the irreversible ownership handover. After this script runs:  - The deployer EOA loses upgrade authority on all UUPS contracts.  - Only the Admin Timelock can authorize upgrades, and only after the 3-day delay.  - Operational and emergency role-gated calls (rescue, pause, cancel, settlement,    mint/burn) remain instant and unaffected. **No rollback**. Once `transferOwnership` is executed, the deployer can no longer recover authority. The script MUST be dry-run on a fork before mainnet. **When adding a new UUPS contract to the protocol**, add a `_transferOwnership` call for it in this script and add a corresponding assertion to `test/integration/TimelockMigration.t.sol::test_PostMigration_AllUUPSContractsOwnedByTimelock`.","kind":"dev","methods":{"run(bool)":{"params":{"writeToJson":"If true, write the timelock address to the deployment output JSON."},"returns":{"adminTimelock":"The deployed `TimelockController` address."}},"run(bool,(address,address,address,address,address,address,address,address,address,address,address,address,address,address,address))":{"details":"Used by tests where contracts are deployed in-memory (no JSON I/O)."}},"title":"13_DeployTimelock","version":1},"userdoc":{"kind":"user","methods":{"run()":{"notice":"Convenience wrapper for real deployments (writes to JSON)."},"run(bool)":{"notice":"Run the deployment reading contract addresses from the deployment output JSON."},"run(bool,(address,address,address,address,address,address,address,address,address,address,address,address,address,address,address))":{"notice":"Run the deployment with explicitly-provided contract addresses."},"setVerbose(bool)":{"notice":"Set verbose mode for logging"},"verbose()":{"notice":"Controls whether deployment logs are printed. @title 13_DeployTimelock
 @notice Phase 6 final deployment step: deploy the Admin Timelock with a 3-day delay,
 configure roles, and transfer ownership of every UUPS contract to it.
 @dev See `docs/timelock-and-governance-spec.md`.
 Reads existing UUPS contract addresses from the deployment output (.json)
 and the admin/guardian Fordefi addresses from the network config (.json).
 Run order: this is the **last** deployment step (after `00`–`12`). It is intentionally
 kept out of the `deploy-all` Make target so the deployer can confirm the protocol
 configuration is correct before performing the irreversible ownership handover.
 After this script runs:
  - The deployer EOA loses upgrade authority on all UUPS contracts.
  - Only the Admin Timelock can authorize upgrades, and only after the 3-day delay.
  - Operational and emergency role-gated calls (rescue, pause, cancel, settlement,
    mint/burn) remain instant and unaffected.
 **No rollback**. Once `transferOwnership` is executed, the deployer can no longer
 recover authority. The script MUST be dry-run on a fork before mainnet.
 **When adding a new UUPS contract to the protocol**, add a `_transferOwnership` call
 for it in this script and add a corresponding assertion to
 `test/integration/TimelockMigration.t.sol::test_PostMigration_AllUUPSContractsOwnedByTimelock`.
